_comment: Stack-specific skills, installed into a repo (not globally) by `spinup.py repo <path> --apply`. A rule fires when any `files` glob matches, or a package.json depends on any `packages`, and (if set) a matched file contains any `contains` string. Sources: docs/research/skills.md.

rules.note: Next ships its own agent docs: on Next < 16.3 run `npx @next/codemod@canary agents-md` once; 16.3+ writes AGENTS.md on `next dev`.
Point AGENTS.md at node_modules/effect/AGENTS.md (the global effect-ts skill does this).
No skill worth adding; describe the build/test workflow (e.g. ./x) in AGENTS.md.
